description: Status line, toasts and /device for the attached Android device; pending viewer annotations ride along with the next prompt and the viewer's Send to Claude submits them (register.ts). The PreToolUse hook lets device actions run without a prompt per tap: per-device consent in the viewer already covers them, as with Claude Desktop's iOS Simulator; build, open_url and the shadowdroid CLI tool keep following the permission mode, and so does plan mode. The SessionStart hook (check-cli) tells Claude how to install the shadowdroid CLI or adb on this OS when they are missing or too old; it never installs anything itself.
